content.short: Intent-centric distributed operating system for building private apps that work on any chain.
content.description: Anoma lets users express what they want, such as a swap or a payment, and leaves the network to work out how to settle it across chains. Developers write against the Anoma App SDK instead of chain-specific contracts, and applications can keep data private by default. Its own products include AnomaPay and the Anoma Portal, and the project is developed by the Anoma Foundation in Switzerland.
content.meta: Anoma is a distributed OS for intent-based, privacy-preserving apps that settle on any chain without chain-specific code.
